A little inspiration in difficult times:

Video

Stand for others.
Defend the bullied.
Support those in need.
Uplift when it’s hardest.
Show up - especially when it matters most.

This principal showed what principled leadership looks like.

Video

Grateful for the courage of Principal Kirk Moore in Oklahoma who ran toward danger, took a bullet, and put himself between harm and his students.

This is what heroism looks like.

But let’s be clear:
this is a kind of bravery that should never be required.

Our children’s leading killer is gun violence.

We cannot just praise courage we must match it.

Honor him not just with words,
but with action.

We must do more to pass common sense gun safety laws to save more of our children.

Video

It’s been three years since the devastating civil war in Sudan started – amid atrocities and mass suffering, at least tens of thousands have been killed, 12 million people have been displaced, and nearly 30 million people need humanitarian aid to survive. 

We cannot look away. We cannot stay silent. America must lead with urgency and compassion—diplomacy, life-saving aid, and accountability now.
